welcome.title: Welcome to Faithful Days
welcome.body: A little space for your spiritual routines, plans and ideas. Make it your own, one choice at a time.
welcome.storage: Routines, plans and notes stay on this device, with no account or sync. Clearing app data or uninstalling can remove your history. Export a backup in Settings before changing devices.

rhythm.title: Your rhythm
rhythm.body: Choose the routines and meeting days that fit your week. Get started will guide you through those choices.

ideas.title: Your ideas
ideas.body: Keep your own questions, notes and preparation together. Editable starters help when you need a starting point.

pace.title: Your pace
pace.body: Read at your own pace or follow a year plan. Small steps count; choose what works for you during setup.

routines.title: Your routines
routines.body: Keep the routines you want to track. Turn a switch off to hide a routine, or tap its pencil to give it your own name.

week.title: Your week
week.meetingHint: Choose the days you normally attend meetings. Preparation appears the day before.
week.pioneerHint: Shows your ministry hours each month.

rhythm.title: Your rhythm
rhythm.anchorQuestion: What could be your daily-text cue?
rhythm.notifyExplainer: Faithful Days can send a gentle reminder at the times you choose. Everything stays on your phone, and it's fine to say no.

links.body: Leave a link empty to use the default.
links.invalid: Use a web address that starts with https:// or http://

backup.body: Save a copy of everything on this device, or bring a copy back.
backup.exportError: The backup couldn't be saved. Please try again.
backup.confirmTitle: Replace all data on this device?
backup.confirmBody: Everything here will be replaced by the backup, and this can't be undone.

errors.notObject: This file isn't a Faithful Days backup.
errors.newerVersion: This backup is from a newer version of Faithful Days. Update the app, then try again.
errors.olderVersion: This backup is from an older version of Faithful Days and can't be read here.
errors.badShape: Parts of this backup can't be read, so nothing was changed.

whatsNew.hint: Open the official jw.org page from Today. No automatic checks or copied content.

reminders.hint: Gentle notes on this device about what's ready today.
reminders.permissionOff: Notifications are turned off for Faithful Days. You can turn them on in your phone's Settings.

about.disclaimer: Faithful Days is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Watch Tower Bible and Tract Society or jw.org, and contains no content from jw.org.
about.diagnostics: Diagnostic history stays on this device. Up to 20 error times and categories are kept; entries older than 7 days are removed when the app opens.

recovery.explanation: The app could not open this screen. Reload first. We cannot verify your saved data from this error screen; save a recovery copy before resetting or reinstalling.
recovery.refreshFailed: Could not refresh app files. Try reloading or contact support.
recovery.noCopy: No saved app data was found. This does not recover unsaved changes.
recovery.copyOffered: A recovery copy was offered. Check that you saved the file before resetting. Keep it private.
recovery.copyFailed: Could not save a recovery copy. Your stored data was not changed.
recovery.acceptReset: I saved a recovery copy or accept losing my current app data.
recovery.reset: Reset current app data and reload
recovery.resetConfirm: Reset current routines, check-ins, reading, study/family plans, badges and settings? Notes, meeting preparation, assignments, recovery copies and other site data will remain. This cannot be undone without a saved backup.
recovery.resetFailed: Could not reset the app data. Contact support before uninstalling.
recovery.support: Avoid reinstalling until you have saved a recovery copy.
